mutations.label: ADR-139 T4: one file in several shards has its counts summed
mutations.from: for (const key of COUNTS) into[key] += Number.isInteger(entry[key]) ? entry[key] : 0
mutations.to: for (const key of COUNTS) into[key] = Number.isInteger(entry[key]) ? entry[key] : 0
mutations.only: ^(?:the Windows shards together reach every test file, and the merged row says when one did not)$
